component.name: Snagster
component.summary: Capture your screen, mark it up, record it

description.p: Snagster takes screenshots and screen recordings, lets you mark them up, and saves or shares them. Everything runs on your own computer.

ul.li: Capture a screen, a window or any area, with a timer if you like
Arrows, text, highlights, blur, steps and shapes that stay editable
Record the screen with sound to MP4 or GIF
Studio: scenes with several sources, and live streaming to several services at once
Read the text in a picture, and a library of everything you took
In 86 languages

screenshot.caption: Go live on several services at once

ul.li: Studio: draw on the screen while streaming, and sound from one program in a scene
A replay buffer saves the last 30 to 120 seconds with a hotkey
Stream details and warnings when the upload or the computer can't keep up
The editor works fully from the keyboard; new marks stay picked to adjust them
Dialogs belong to Snagster's window; Wayland screen captures see every screen
Wayland: screen sharing is asked once and remembered, for recording, streaming and captures
Wayland: hotkeys go through the desktop, which lets you change them
Follows the desktop's accent colour; GNOME's title bar; a main menu on GNOME and KDE
Keyboard shortcuts match the menus; screen readers can read the buttons
Wayland: no more screenshot loop; Studio, recording and streaming use screen sharing
Wayland: captures open the desktop's own screenshot tool instead of seeming frozen
Recording waits for screen sharing, and the recording bar stays small
A Flatpak download for every Linux distribution
Print Screen works while Snagster is in the tray
Updating works when an older copy is still running
The Linux download runs on Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13 and other current systems
Works on Wayland and inside a Flatpak: recording and streaming use the desktop's screen sharing
A menu entry and store listing for Linux
Inside a Flatpak, updates come from Flatpak
Recent lists the pictures and videos you took before
Capture a window from a list
One Snagster at a time
Settings and dialogs open in their own centered windows
Choose which graphics card encodes
Go live on several services at once from one encode
Studio is the live workspace, with per-scene sound
Choose the video encoder
